stories.title: Red Cross transfers freed Palestinian detainees to Gaza's Nasser Hospital
stories.summary: Red Cross transfers freed Palestinian detainees to Gaza's Nasser Hospital The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) helped transfer 13 released Palestinian detainees from the Kerem Shalom crossing to Nasser Hospital in Gaza, and assisted in reuniting them with their families, Haaretz reported. The ICRC said it has been denied access to detainees held in Israeli detention facilities since October 2023, and called on Israeli authorities to disclose their whereabouts and permit visits. It added that talks are ongoing with Israeli authorities to resume such visits.
